title: Dhaene et al. (2022) · Cadmium n-tetradecylphosphinate preparation

conflictPairs.context: Formula is elemental-analysis formula, not unique coordination structure.

Main p. 8 / printed p. 7368 reports CdO 642.1 mg, 5 mmol, 1 equiv and reports product formula C28H60O4P2Cd with 4.7 g isolated at 93%. The source does not state the basis needed to reconcile the printed product mass/yield with the stated precursor/product formula; retain the reported figures without replacing the yield.

Main p. 8 / printed p. 7368 reports n-tetradecylphosphinic acid 10.05 mmol and 2.1 equiv alongside 5 mmol CdO. The printed amount and equivalent value do not arithmetically agree on that basis; preserve both source values and leave the basis unresolved.

general_background.title: From a metal precursor to reactive species
general_background.summary: A metal precursor supplies the metal, while its ligands and conversion chemistry influence how reactive species become available. Stronger or more persistent coordination can slow release of reactive metal species, while ligand exchange can open alternative conversion pathways.
